title: DevOps Engineer
full_description:
Makati City, Philippines
At ING we value and support our employees before recruiting external talent. If you think this vacancy is the right next step in your ING career, we’d encourage you to apply. Should you have questions about the vacancy or need to hear more before you feel you can apply. Please do not hesitate to reach out to the responsible recruiter.
Join us! Your role will be to design, create, own, and maintain systems and service deployments. You will play a crucial role in continuously improving our infrastructure for better scalability, security, and fault tolerance. By integrating DevOps methodology into development, deployment, and operations lifecycle, you will enable rapid deployment of new product features while ensuring stability, high availability, and performance. This is an exciting opportunity to optimize infrastructure, phase out legacy systems, and proactively troubleshoot cloud and infrastructure resources.
You are an energetic DevOps Engineer with a passion for IT and a positive can-do mindset. You are a team player working as a core member of a multidisciplinary and cross-functional squad whom primary driver is the customer. Close collaboration within and across the squads and with the consumer is of utmost importance for you.
You have a broad and diverse set of competencies that allow you to design, develop, test and deliver applications in the scope of your squad. When necessary, you will also contribute to applications maintenance, administering them and eventually decommissioning them.
As a DevOps Engineer, you contribute to accomplishing the squad's purpose. You do this by working on the customer journey from the backlog, using the Agile method end-to-end. You continuously strive to improve yourself and your colleagues.
As a DevOps Engineer, you control both the design phase and the actual development and testing of our applications. You understand the entire stack, so that you can bring applications into production and resolve incidents.
You are in constant dialogue with your tribe: you understand the goal of our business and work in a team of experts to find the most relevant solution for the customer’s needs
Roles and responsibilities
Continuously improveinfrastructure for scalability, security, and fault tolerance
IntegrateDevOps methodologyinto development, deployment, and operations lifecycle
Develop super clean and well-structured deployment,monitoring, and application management scripts
Enable rapid deployment of new product features while ensuringstability, high availability, andperformance
Optimize infrastructure and phase out legacy systems
Monitor and proactively troubleshoot infrastructure resources
Ensure system security compliance with ING standards and policies (IT RISK)
Scripting (Powershell, Bash, Python, and similar) skills.
Advanced to proficient knowledge in RHEL, Windows, Websphere, MQ
Risk, Vulnerability, and LifeCycle Management
Working knowledge of containerization i.e. (Docker, Kubernetes or similar)
Azure Devops, CI/CD, Ansible
Basic knowledge of Oracle RDBMS
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you'll stay curious, keep learning, and take on responsibility. In this role, the following skills and experiences will help you succeed:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent
Strong networking skills
A risk first mindset on developing and maintaining applications
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, preferably Azure DevOps in combination with Ansible
Proficiency in shell scripting or another scripting language
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
